paper.title_en: Peeling property for the Einstein scalar field equations with the nonzero cosmological constant
paper.abstract_en: Inspired by interaction of gravitational waves, dark matters and dark energy, we study the Einstein scalar field equations with the nonzero cosmological constant for the Bondi-Sachs metrics. We provide the asymptotic expansions under the outgoing radiation condition. Unlike the case of the zero cosmological constant, the asymptotic expansions depend on four additional $Λ$-independent functions $B(u, θ, ϕ)$, $\tilde{X}(u, θ, ϕ)$, $\tilde{Y}(u, θ, ϕ)$ and $\tilde{I}(u)$. We show that, under suitable coordinate transformation, we can make $B(u, θ, ϕ)=0$. We prove the peeling property for the Einstein scalar field equations if $\tilde{I}=0$, and derive a loss formula of the Bondi energy-momentum for the nonzero cosmological constant. We remark that, for certain real data from gravitational waves, the loss formula is likely to indicate the loss property of the Bondi energy-momentum.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了非零宇宙学常数下爱因斯坦标量场方程的剥离性质，涉及引力波与暗物质/暗能量相互作用的背景，属于广义相对论基础领域。提供了渐近展开、剥离性质证明以及Bondi能量-动量损失公式，具有理论深度和潜在重要性。
decision.title_zh: 非零宇宙学常数下爱因斯坦标量场方程的剥离性质
decision.abstract_zh: 受引力波、暗物质和暗能量相互作用的启发，我们研究了Bondi-Sachs度规下具有非零宇宙学常数的爱因斯坦标量场方程。我们在出射辐射条件下提供了渐近展开。与零宇宙学常数的情况不同，渐近展开依赖于四个额外的、与$\Lambda$无关的函数$B(u, θ, ϕ)$、$\tilde{X}(u, θ, ϕ)$、$\tilde{Y}(u, θ, ϕ)$和$\tilde{I}(u)$。我们表明，在适当的坐标变换下，我们可以使$B(u, θ, ϕ)=0$。我们证明了当$\tilde{I}=0$时爱因斯坦标量场方程的剥离性质，并推导了非零宇宙学常数下Bondi能量-动量的损失公式。我们指出，对于某些来自引力波的真实数据，损失公式可能表明Bondi能量-动量的损失性质。
